description: Create or replace an automation: a scheduled action on the app (open a room, hand a room data, call one of your API secrets). For flows across the tools the developer already uses, n8n, Make or Zapier connect through the admin API, incoming webhooks and outgoing webhooks. when: { at: ISO date } once; { every: minutes } (5 – 10080); or { daily: "HH:MM", days?: [0–6, 0 = Sunday], tz?: "Europe/Madrid" (UTC by default) }. action: { kind: "openRoom", room, config?, openForMinutes? (60) } books the room with its config, so whoever enters first finds it in neblla.room.config; { kind: "message", room, data } hands data to that live room’s server file as neblla.room.on("hook", ({ name, data }) => …) (name = this automation); { kind: "callApi", secret, path, method?, body? } calls one of your API secrets (neblla_set_api_secret). Up to 50 per app; each run is recorded in lastResult. Or, instead of action, a ready-made template: template "booking.reminder" { set, secret, path?, hoursAhead? (24) } — one call per booking starting soon, each once ({ event, player: { id, name, email if granted }, slot, booking }); "community.digest" { days? (7), limit? (10), secret and/or room } — the week top entries; "game.dailyTournament" { board, day? ("today" | "yesterday", UTC), top? (10), secret and/or room } — the day's top of a protected ranking (neblla.scores, declared with neblla_update_app scores), kept and announced as { event, board, day, ranking: [{ place, player, value, at, info? }] }; or { table, field, top?, hours? (24), secret and/or room } — the rows of one of your tables in the period, which players can write.

board.description: game.dailyTournament: a ranking of neblla.scores (instead of table and field)

day.description: game.dailyTournament with board: the UTC day ranked (today by default)

enabled.description: false keeps it without running (default true)

name.description: Automation name: a letter, then letters, digits, _ or - (≤ 40)

room.description: Template: a live room whose server file hears it as a hook

secret.description: Template: the API secret its results go to

template.description: A ready-made template instead of action

name: neblla_set_automation
title: Set automation
